_about: Extra tabs the sheet script creates. Changing this file in GitHub changes the sheet at the next update (or Frederick Leads > Refresh instructions and tabs). Columns are only ever added, never removed, and existing data is never changed.

columns.name: Date entered
columns.note: The day you added this row.

columns.name: Case type
columns.note: What kind of filing or trigger this is.

columns.name: Case number
columns.note: Case or estate number, exactly as shown in the search results.

columns.name: Filing date
columns.note: The date the case or estate was filed.

columns.name: Names
columns.note: Party names as shown (defendant, decedent, etc.). Separate several names with a semicolon.

columns.name: Property address
columns.note: Street address of the property, if the search results show one (e.g. 123 MAIN ST). Leave blank if there is none.

columns.name: City
columns.note: City or town of the property address.

columns.name: ZIP
columns.note: 5-digit ZIP code of the property address.

columns.name: Case status
columns.note: Status shown in the search results (e.g. Open, Closed).

columns.name: Notes
columns.note: Anything else worth keeping. You can paste a whole line from the search results here.

columns.name: Matched Account ID
columns.note: Filled in automatically (Session 3): the property this filing matched in the database.

columns.name: Match result
columns.note: Filled in automatically (Session 3): Matched, No match, or Needs name lookup.
